shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,110p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; printf '\\n--- package.json ---\\n'; cat package.json; printf '\\n--- App ---\\n'; sed -n '1,240p' src/App.tsx; printf '\\n--- main ---\\n'; cat src/main.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "npm install @gravity-ui/date-components @gravity-ui/date-utils && node -e \"for (const p of ['@gravity-ui/date-components','@gravity-ui/date-utils']) console.log(p, require(p+'/package.json').version)\""

/bin/bash -lc 'npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@4 version peerDependencies; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@3 version peerDependencies; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@2 version peerDependencies; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components versions --json | tail -40'

/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/date-components@4.1.0 @gravity-ui/date-utils@''^2.6.0 && printf '"'\\n--- local docs index ---\\n'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/build/docs 2>/dev/null || true; printf '\\n--- exports ---\\n'; rg 'Calendar|DatePicker|DateTimeField' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/build/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/docs/INDEX.md; printf '\\n--- component files ---\\n'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/docs/components; printf '\\n--- calendar doc ---\\n'; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/docs/components -iname '*calendar*' -maxdepth 2 -print -exec sed -n '1,220p' {} \\;; printf '\\n--- readme setup ---\\n'; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/README.md"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/docs/components/Calendar.md; printf '\\n--- d.ts ---\\n'; rg -n \"interface CalendarProps|type CalendarProps|const Calendar|declare function Calendar|export.*Calendar\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist -g '*.d.ts' | head -60"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -A50 'export interface CalendarProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/Calendar/Calendar.d.ts; rg -n -A60 'interface ValueBase|type ValueBase' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/node_modules -g '*.d.ts' 2>/dev/null | head -80; rg -n -A40 '@react-types/calendar' package-lock.json | head -100"
/bin/bash -lc 'command -v apply_patch || find / -name apply_patch -type f 2>/dev/null | head -5; git status --short'

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
path = Path('src/main.tsx')
text = path.read_text()
text = text.replace(\"import { ThemeProvider } from '@gravity-ui/uikit';\", \"import { ThemeProvider } from '@gravity-ui/uikit';\\nimport { settings } from '@gravity-ui/date-utils';\")
text = text.replace(\"<ThemeProvider theme=\\\"light\\\">\", \"<ThemeProvider theme=\\\"light\\\" lang=\\\"ru\\\">\")
text = text.replace(\"import { App } from './App';\", \"import { App } from './App';\\n\\nvoid settings.loadLocale('ru');\")
path.write_text(text)
PY
npm run build"

/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba src/App.tsx | sed -n '1,30p'; printf '\\n---\\n'; nl -ba src/main.tsx | sed -n '1,35p'; printf '\\n---deps---\\n'; rg '\"@gravity-ui/(date-components|date-utils)\"' package.json"
